exposure: Misoprostol use for second-trimester pregnancy termination
Number of previous caesarean sections (0, 1, 2 or more)
cohort: 359 patients who underwent pregnancy termination with misoprostol alone between 14 and 24 weeks gestation due to fetal anomalies
finding: Misoprostol alone is a safe and effective option for terminating second-trimester pregnancies, even in women with one or more previous caesarean sections, in settings where mifepristone is unavailable.
mod_finding: There was no difference in complications in women with prior CS when they were compared according to the misoprostol regimens used.
